GREELANG 1: First Year First quarter Modern Greek is the first course in a three quarter sequence. Course emphasizes developing basic level communication skills using daily life topics. Grammatical structures and vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive and presentational modes of communication. Modern Greek culture.
GREELANG 2: Continuation of GREELANG 1. First Year Second Quarter Modern Greek is the second course in a three quarter sequence. Course emphasizes further development of basic level communication skills using daily life topics. Grammatical structures and vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive and presentational modes of communication. Modern Greek culture. Prerequisite: GREELANG 1 or placement test. Prerequisite: GREELANG 1.
GREELANG 3: Continuation of GREELANG 2. First Year Third Quarter Modern Greek is the third course in a three quarter sequence. Course emphasizes further developing basic level communication skills using daily life topics. Grammatical structures and vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive and presentational modes of communication. Modern Greek culture. Prerequisite: GREELANG 2. Fulfills the University language requirement.
GREELANG 21: Continuation of GREELANG 3. Second Year Modern Greek, First Quarter in a three quarter sequence. The course integrates language and culture with an emphasis on developing proficiency in oral and written discourse. Targeted functional abilities include presentational and socio-culturally appropriate language in formal and informal contexts. Prerequisite: GREELANG 3 or placement test.
GREELANG 22: Continuation of GREELANG 21. Second Year Modern Greek, Second Quarter in a three quarter sequence. The course integrates language and culture with an emphasis on further developing proficiency in oral and written discourse. Targeted functional abilities include presentational and socio-culturally appropriate language in formal and informal contexts. Prerequisite: GREELANG 21 or placement test
GREELANG 23: Continuation of GREELANG 22. Second Year Modern Greek, Third Quarter in a three quarter sequence. The course integrates language and culture with an emphasis on further developing proficiency in oral and written discourse. Targeted functional abilities include presentational and socio-culturally appropriate language in formal and informal contexts. Prerequisite: GREELANG 22 or placement test.
GREELANG 101: Third Year Modern Greek First Quarter is the first course in a three quarter sequence. Focus of the course is on developing communication and presentation skills in Modern Greek using a variety of topics and different contexts. Authentic audio-visual material and use of level appropriate pedagogy tools enhance functional linguistic abilities. Culture is an essential part of the course. Prerequisite: GREELANG 23 or placement test.
GREELANG 102: Third Year Modern Greek Second Quarter is the second course in a three quarter sequence. Focus of the course is on developing more advanced communication and presentation skills in Modern Greek using a variety of topics and different contexts. Authentic audio-visual material and use of level appropriate pedagogy tools enhance functional linguistic abilities. Culture is an essential part of the course. Prerequisite: GREELANG 101 or placement test.
GREELANG 103: Third Year Modern Greek Third Quarter is the third course in a three quarter sequence. Focus of the course is on developing more advanced communication and presentation skills in Modern Greek using a variety of topics and different contexts. Authentic audio-visual material and use of level appropriate pedagogy tools enhance functional linguistic abilities. Culture is an essential part of the course. Prerequisite: GREELANG 102 or placement test.
